description: A huge, dark-brown-skinned humanoid lunges to the right, shown full figure in profile from the party's eye level. It is bald with a tuft of blue-black hair on top, a heavy brow and a jutting jaw. It wears a round grey metal plate at its belly and a skirt of yellow, spotted animal hide, and has grey cuffs at its ankles. Red streaks run down its body like blood or war paint. Its legs are bent in a deep stride, and both hands grip a long spear with a pale steel head held low across its body, pointing down to the right. The background is a plain teal field. The colors are strong and simple, and the mood is aggressive. Frame 1: the spear is drawn back with the point at the middle right, briefly. Frame 2: the spear drives forward and down to full reach, held for a long moment. Frame 3: the spear pulls back slightly, briefly. The loop reads as a sharp jab that holds at full extension, then a quick recoil.
title: Spear-wielding brute lunging
